weighted.conclusion: On unchanged heads the guarded static-Weighted policy removes seven physical eth_call items and six amount quote tasks while retaining byte-identical effective amounts/statuses. No stable aggregate stage latency gain is claimed: the prior silent pair was slightly slower overall and the graph contains only one Balancer instance.

curveAndHook.conclusion: Small-topology updates show no second-scale transport permit queue. Plain retains code/ramp guards; Underlying was freshly quoted only on the first measured head and reused on the next two. This is not three independent fresh-Underlying performance proofs, a full-graph comparison, or a Curve latency-fix verdict.
curveAndHook.freshnessBoundary: Underlying mutation is pool-log based; declarations of registry/coin dependencies do not by themselves prove all external-dependency changes are observed. No historical stale-output failure has been established here.

limitations: Small shared-VM diagnostic, not exclusive CPU or production live acceptance.

Family task spans overlap and must not be summed into total stage time.
Direct get-code/get-storage reads lack per-item eth_call attribution; mixed-family work is shared/unattributed, not forcibly assigned.
No independent final sim/EV ran in these effective profiles.
Phase1 dual-interface tests and the single Hook execution sample do not prove historical execution for all Family variants; previous missing historical evidence remains missing.
